data.title: 和泉纱雾 · 截稿前的画面讨论
data.description: 夜里的绘图房间，纱雾穿粉色薄荷滚边连帽衫与灰色家居长裤，坐在画桌前把数位屏稍稍转向你。一只手握笔停在尚未完成的构图线上，另一只手扶稳屏幕，认真等你指出需要调整的地方。屏幕光照亮双手，房间其余部分安静地隐入暗处。
data.action: 一手握笔停在构图线上，另一手扶稳转向同行者的数位屏，认真听取意见。
data.lighting: drawing-tablet glow across the hands and face, a dim room behind the desk
data.camera: medium shot, drawing tablet and both hands visible
data.promptProse: Sagiri pauses with the stylus above an unfinished composition and turns the drawing tablet toward the viewer with her free hand. Its glow lights her fingers and attentive face while the bedroom behind the desk stays dim.
